annotations.title: AST-Audited Ephemeral Python Code Execution Sandbox

description: Audits Python source code for forbidden syscalls (os, subprocess, socket, open, eval) and simulates isolated stdout execution. Use when running untrusted LLM-generated Python snippets inside an isolated sandbox; for checking shell commands or tool arguments without executing Python code, use verify_agent_command_safety instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'code' ('timeout_profile' defaults to 'fast_1s'), supports '?demo=true' or MPP (1500 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

code.description: Python 3 source code snippet to audit and execute in the isolated sandbox.

timeout_profile.description: Execution resource ceiling; defaults to 'standard_5s' when omitted.

name: execute_python_sandbox

ast_security_audit.description: Static syscall audit summary including flagged_calls and safety_verdict.

exit_code.description: Process exit status (0 on clean execution, 1 on security block).

simulated_stdout.description: Captured standard output from the isolated execution.

syntax_valid.description: True if the Python source parses without syntax errors.
